system.description:
You are well versed in the phenomenon of death in all its guises: decrepitude and aging, the effects of plague and illness (though this Knowledge may not normally substitute for Medicine), and the metaphysics of what happens to the spirit when its mortal host dies. You are also skilled at preserving corpses, through mummification, embalming, or other methods, and may attempt to determine a subject's cause of death when it is not obvious.

Possessed by: Cappadocians, necromancers, Giovanni, priests, cultists, heretics.

Specialties: Cultural Beliefs, Religious Beliefs, Wraiths, Causes of Death.
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
